facts.fact: HCN central director Mohamed Louail said all portal data is secured under Law 25-11 on personal data protection, based on Law 18-07 as amended, plus Presidential Decree 25-320 on national data governance.
Louail said the National Authority for Personal Data Protection, with the information systems security agency, monitors data exchanges between government sectors for conformity with law.
facts.system: National Authority for Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: Louail said the portal and related projects form part of implementing the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030, which aims to modernise public administration and expand digital services.
The National Digital Transformation Strategy is stated to cover 2025-2030.

Louail said the National Digital Services Portal offers 21 services in its first phase, including civil status certificates, residence and family status certificates, social security attestations, unemployment benefit and disability card services, with more to follow.

The one national portal carries services of the interior, transport, labour and social security and solidarity sectors, and users sign up for a temporary digital identity with their national ID number and personal details, per Louail.

facts.fact: Louail said the National Digital Services Center provides cloud services to public institutions and administrations so they can host their data and localise digital services in virtual data centres, without building their own, using two active-active sites at Mohammadia (Algiers) and Blida.
